name: Balu Forge Industries Ltd
about: Balu Forge Industries Ltd is engaged in the manufacturing of fully finished and semi-finished forged crankshafts and Forged Components. It has the capability to manufacture components conforming to the New Emission Regulations & the New Energy Vehicles [1]
keyPoints:
Product Offerings
The company manufactures fully finished and semi-finished forged components like crankshafts, railway wheels, transmission clutches, hydraulic motors, hooks, brake parts, etc. [1] [2]
